title: CI, bazel-nightly: TF, TF serving, and bazel-tests are failing

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
https://ci.bazel.io/job/Global/job/TensorFlow/311/console
https://ci.bazel.io/job/Global/job/TensorFlow_Serving/301/consoleFull
https://ci.bazel.io/job/Global/job/bazel-tests/383/consoleFull

Likely culprit: 7cf1c694a3f949717be06b3b6c8e6a20e22cb83f

The test ran with a Bazel binary built at https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/ddd5ac16aeffa6c4693c348f73e7365240b1abc5.

EDIT(2017-12-06): this should not block https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/3773 because it's not a bug in Bazel, it requires updating some BUILD files.
~Blocking: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/3773~
